canonical_text: I am for a rule at my daughter's high school. It would keep phones off during breaks and lunch, too. Only banning them in class is not enough. I get home late from the job site. Fighting about phones every night makes me tired. If the school has the same rule, I won't be the only bad guy. My daughter did not keep our agreement. She was supposed to put her phone in the living-room charging basket. I took her phone away. The next morning, it was hard to talk to her at breakfast. She also said, If I am the only one who replies late, I will be left out. Her words left me speechless. A promise is a promise, and I want it kept. Shouting like my father is not what I want, either. But if she can't use her phone at school, nothing changes at home at night. Maybe I just want the school to help so my life is easier. I am a site supervisor who can't even manage things at home.
